svg.title: headless-kit
svg.desc: headless-kit: 20 cheap, agent-first tools and Claude Code hooks (14 tools, 6 hooks) that run with no browser, sign-in or window, with zero dependencies and CI on Windows and Ubuntu: model routing, Claude Code hooks, machine guards, research and trackers. reddit-pull and detached-run are part of it. Frames: real terminal runs of model-router, reddit-pull, memory-gate and focus-gate. Opens github.com/Sohwhat6420/headless-kit.
